entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Query precompilation throws NullReferenceException when the DbContext is a member of a local (`lease.Database.Users...`) #39542
  • Precompiled queries: `ids.Contains(e.Id)` over a captured array or collection fails (MemoryExtensions binding; InvalidCastException in SqlNullabilityProcessor) #39541
  • Query precompilation is all-or-nothing per project; allow writing the interceptors of the queries that did precompile #39540
  • Backport query-precompiler fixes (method parameters, captured members, ExecuteUpdate setter order) to 10.0.x #39539
  • Question on possibility of general RelationalShapedQueryCompilingExpressionExpressionVisitor updates #39534

Closed

  • Query precompiler throws Non-IQueryable first parameter for ThenInclude #39274
    12.0-preview1
  • Precompiled queries reconstruct nullable-long coalesce with nullable result in anonymous projection #39309
    12.0-preview1
  • Global UseCollation() convention generates uncompilable model snapshot for JSON-mapped ComplexCollection properties #39406
    12.0-preview1
  • Precompiled queries evaluate guarded Nullable<T>.Value during design-time parameter extraction #39308
    12.0-preview1
  • Query precompiler throws parameter-evaluation NRE for captured object properties #39272
    12.0-preview1
  • A cancelled connection open does not reach interceptors: the async path calls the sync ConnectionCanceled, and the composite interceptor forwards neither #39254
    12.0-preview1
  • JsonColumn with primitive collection in Select throws NullReference exception #39255
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/9.0] Update branding to 9.0.24 #39538
    branding-update
  • Don't escape quotes and apostrophes in scaffolded XML comments #39536
    community-contribution
  • Translate `Array.Exists` to `Queryable.Any` #39535
    community-contribution

Merged

  • Add convention builder APIs for JSON mapping #39513
    api-review
  • Fix query precompiler rejecting ThenInclude sources #39297
  • Fix Build: Disable NuGet auditing in file-based app test #39512
  • Preserve nonnullable coalesce results in precompiled queries #39314
  • Omit unsupported collations from complex-collection snapshots #39481
  • Validate and uniquify complex-property column names #39290
    area-harness
  • Fix query precompilation for captured object properties #39305
    area-harness
  • Fix connection cancellation notifications to interceptors #39293
  • Fix SQL Server split-query projections of primitive JSON collections #39294
    area-harness

Updated

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39516
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39543
  • Release completed migration instances #39520
    community-contribution
  • Fix scalar ExecuteUpdate setter query precompilation #39307
  • Add model-wide and member JSON reader/writer configuration #39483
    api-review
  • Preserve independent Skip/Take parameters in precompiled queries #39478
    area-harness
  • Preserve implicit conversions during query precompilation #39313
    area-harness
  • Handle implicit numeric literal conversions in query precompilation #39312
    area-harness
  • Preserve captured-dependent branches during query precompilation #39479
    area-harness
  • Support required-member DTO initializers in query precompilation #39311
    area-harness
  • Make JSON complex types nullable over a LEFT JOIN #39524
    community-contribution
  • Improve remaining JsonReaderInvalidTokenType exceptions during JSON materialization #39517
    community-contribution
